fix: during the long war against Nabis, who was a neighbor of the Megalopolitans, he had spent all that time serving under Philopoemen and had thus gained real training in military action
reason: ἀστυγείτονος agrees with πολέμου (a war with a neighbor); τεταγμένος is singular, so Diophanes served under Philopoemen.

fix: and reflecting that only in this way could he prevent the crossing of the land army and in general keep the war away from Asia [...] if he securely commanded the sea, he resolved to fight a naval battle
reason: Lacuna after ἀποτρίβεσθαι must be marked; 'only by mastering the sea' blends across it. 'if' reflects the optative κρατοίη; convention [...].

fix: [...] not to change their location for thirty days during the season of the sacrifice, wherever they may happen to be caught.
reason: Sentence begins after a lacuna; 'the law requires' supplied over it; [οἱ σάλιοι οὗτοι] is an editorial deletion, so omitted.

fix: the Romans had just taken possession of Sardis and its citadel [...] Musaeus came from Antiochus under flag of truce.
reason: Lacuna after ἄρτι must be marked; ἄρτι ('just') was dropped. Plural ἀκροπόλεις can denote one citadel; keep.

fix: Publius said that the Romans never became harsher after victory [...]
reason: οὔτε lacks its second member; lacuna follows. Mark it, convention [...].

fix: So they separated on those terms, and in the following days the Romans divided their forces [...]
reason: Lacuna after διεῖλον τὰς δυνάμεις; mark with [...].

fix: but would remain [...] entirely leaving those matters in Roman hands.
reason: Lacuna after μεῖναι; 'continue to' bridged it. Keep μεῖναι as 'remain', mark gap, render διδοὺς τὴν ἐξουσίαν.

fix: I would never, so far as lies in my power, give way to any living man.
reason: κατὰ δύναμιν means 'so far as in my power', not 'knowingly'. Kept existing 'any living man'.

fix: being the first of almost all who live in Asia and Greece to share your friendship and alliance
reason: σχεδὸν ('almost') omitted; claim overstated without it.

fix: can be given by you to whomever you wish [...]
reason: Lacuna after βούλησθε; mark with project convention [...], not '[gap in the Greek text here]'. 'given' recoverable from οἷς ἂν βούλησθε.

fix: while only those that had paid tribute to Antiochus should have that tribute remitted.
reason: μόνον modifies ταύταις: only these cities are released; 'Antiochus alone' misattaches it.
Σκιπίωνα is singular; 'the Scipios' wrong. Greek compressed/corrupt: likely L. Scipio (Magnesia) and L. Aemilius Regillus (naval victor). Editor decide.
